about_the_game:
Animas: Prologue is a first-person psychological horror game that immerses you in the abandoned home of the Blanco family to uncover the roots of their tragedy. With no weapons or defenses, your only tools are your wits and your attention to detail. Investigate every room, examine forgotten objects, and piece together the story through letters, photographs, and terrifying supernatural events that blur the line between memory and reality.

A Standalone Prologue

This demo is a standalone, self-contained story; an introduction to the world of Animas that will not be part of the final game. Here, you will take on the role of Ana, a journalist tasked with reconstructing the timeline of events that doomed the Blanco family.

A Taste of Venezuelan Horror

The Animas experience is deeply rooted in Venezuelan culture. Every detail has been carefully crafted to create an authentic atmosphere, from the architecture and decor to a story steeped in our traditions and folklore. Immersion is enhanced by full voice acting from a talented Venezuelan cast, offering a unique journey into a side of horror rarely explored in video games.

The walls of the Blanco home have a story to tell. Are you brave enough to listen?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes and intense content, including symbolic violence, religious rituals inspired by real-world traditions (featuring non-explicit human sacrifice and self-mutilation), gore elements (blood, mutilated bodies), and sensitive narratives such as domestic abuse, familial trauma, and suicide. Discretion is advised for players sensitive to these topics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (or better)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB) or RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Animas Prologue is a standalone chapter in the Animas story, allowing you to explore the Blanco family home for the first time and begin to uncover its dark secrets.
